reply.summary: Llilear is a gentle thermal adept who bends scorching heat and biting frost with equal ease. Llilear has hung up the heroics, preferring a quiet kitchen inside a shared daydream to the battlefield.

feats.scene: Llilear flash-boils a reservoir-sized pond in a single exhale during an old skirmish.
Llilear walks out of a collapsing furnace hall without a blister.

reply.summary: Nulennas is a deathless warrior-mystic who commands her own body heat and can project blazing or freezing force. Nulennas trained among mountain monks and fights with disciplined, graceful strikes.

feats.scene: Nulennas vents a pillar of frost and flame that fells a fortified tower.
Nulennas shrugs off a vehicle-sized blast while holding a mountain pass.

reply.summary: Tisti is a swarm of sentient hypergeometries older than space itself, able to reshape any rule of reality. Tisti speaks mind to mind and treats whole universes as sketches to be erased or redrawn.

feats.scene: Tisti folds a vast cluster of galaxies into a single bent line.
Tisti remains unaltered as a collapsing cosmos is poured through its angles.

reply.summary: Eormiti is a restless sorceress whose spells are fed by a small jade idol hidden in a derelict warehouse. Eormiti sows chaos from boredom and sabotages machines from the shadows.

feats.scene: Eormiti hurls a rolling wave of sorcery that tears through a convention hall and scatters the crowd.
Eormiti shrugs off a volley of armoured gauntlet fire behind a shimmering ward.

reply.summary: Reseaus is a grey-haired archivist of a fiery tyrant realm, trusted to remember every grim legend. Reseaus has little talent for combat but guards a vast library of forbidden tales.

feats.scene: Reseaus hurls a heavy stone tablet across the vault at an intruder.
Reseaus survives a tumbling shelf of iron-bound volumes without a bruise.

reply.summary: Leniullo is a scaled mercenary whose body was rebuilt by swarms of microscopic machines. Leniullo guarded his employer faithfully, unaware that the same machines carried a hidden kill-switch.

feats.scene: Leniullo hammers a reinforced door off its hinges during a raid.
Leniullo takes a burst of rifle fire without slowing his advance.

reply.summary: Irllsi is a sour, rebellious painter who found a stolen wand that turns stone into sculpture. Irllsi went on a surreal rampage, remaking famous monuments as bizarre art until his confidence cracked.

feats.scene: Irllsi twists a historic bridge tower into a giant melting clock with one flick.
Irllsi takes a hard knock from a heckler's bottle and keeps painting.

reply.summary: Antalsi is a penniless travelling painter who became monarch of a volcanic island after accidentally toppling its tyrant. Antalsi rules clumsily but is beloved by common people.

feats.scene: Antalsi stumbles into a dictator and sends him flying through a window.
Antalsi tumbles down a palace staircase and laughs it off.

reply.summary: Valsonntu is a wartime tinkerer whose body was partly replaced by machinery of his own design. Valsonntu serves a covert team, mending devices under fire.

feats.scene: Valsonntu overloads a generator to blow a wall off a bunker.
Valsonntu stays upright after a shell lands within arm's reach.

reply.summary: Mianti is a mind-reaching patrol officer of an interstellar police force, sworn to guard a quiet sector. Mianti died defending a power ring, sending a last warning across space before destroying the ring.

feats.scene: Mianti sends a lance of green force that cracks open an enemy cruiser.
Mianti holds a shimmering shield against a swarm of assassins until it fails.

reply.summary: Siustiosa is a compassionate future ruler of a peaceful world republic who believes love beats force. Siustiosa once talked a would-be bomber out of ruin before the blast could happen.

feats.scene: Siustiosa pushes a startled attacker away from the podium.
Siustiosa stays calm and unhurt as a heavy podium topples beside her.

reply.summary: Ntasnt is a rich college girl and sorority prankster with a surprising knack for blasting things apart. Ntasnt helps an amazon heroine track a murderer to his hidden den.

feats.scene: Ntasnt wires charges that drop the roof of a smuggler's hideout.
Ntasnt tumbles down a dusty cellar stair and bounces right back up.

reply.summary: Tirreran is an ancient lord of sorcery, one of several elder beings who lend their gifts to a chosen wizard. Tirreran can move at blinding pace and divide power among worthy mortals.

feats.scene: Tirreran strikes a ridge with a bolt of raw sorcery that levels its summit.
Tirreran stands unmoved as a collapsing peak buries his hall.

reply.summary: Secotor is a grim war deity who flies, teleports, hurls lightning and disintegrates foes with heat. Secotor thrives on bloodshed and deceives mortals into slaughter, disguising himself as a gentle official.

feats.scene: Secotor lets loose a storm of lightning that flattens an entire district of a battle-torn town.
Secotor strides out of a crater unmarked after a barrage of bolts.

reply.summary: Ressau is a scornful immortal of battle who despises mortals for fighting among themselves. Ressau is a bruiser, nearly unbreakable, who hurls his enemies around by the dozen.

feats.scene: Ressau punches through a stone wall and sends its masonry across a courtyard.
Ressau takes a collapsing temple roof on his shoulders and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Seslusa is a patient old deity who poses as a smooth businessman, stoking conflict between nations for sport. Seslusa projects force, reads distant minds, and cannot die of age.

feats.scene: Seslusa flings a blazing bolt that erupts through a hangar in a ball of fire.
Seslusa takes a missile salvo to the chest and straightens his tie.

reply.summary: Reorau is a vain ageless deity who has traded battlefields for the stage of a beachside club. Reorau puts more effort into his oiled routine than into any quarrel.

feats.scene: Reorau tosses a heckler out through a bamboo door without looking up.
Reorau laughs as a ceiling fan crashes onto his head.

reply.summary: Tarne is an ancient immortal embodiment of brute conflict, boasting that all mortals worship force. Tarne rules a dark underworld seat and pits chosen champions against his rivals.

feats.scene: Tarne smashes his fist into a hillside and the whole slope slides into the valley.
Tarne wades out of a burning hall that has just been razed around him.

reply.summary: Isilau is a red-eyed brawler who fires a searing ray from a single eye. Isilau ended up sold into an arena as a fighting slave after being hunted down for a reward.

feats.scene: Isilau melts a gap through an arena gate with a thin beam from his eye.
Isilau climbs back up after a heavy club blow cracks the sand beneath him.

reply.summary: Rilter is a tiny, scarred pest in a tin mask who nurses a petty grudge and swipes laundry as a hobby. Rilter is weightless, spiteful and not nearly as dangerous as he imagines.

feats.scene: Rilter flings a pebble that pings off a lamp shade.
Rilter survives a cat's swat that sends him skidding across the floor.

reply.summary: Nelnt is a masked gunman guarding a harbour city from raiders. Nelnt stopped a terror cell from wrecking the city's famous sail-roofed theatre, with help from a passing stranger.

feats.scene: Nelnt fires a rifle and drops a bomber at fifty paces.
Nelnt rolls clear of a falling scaffold and rises with a bruise.

reply.summary: Ntotelval is a stern cavalry captain from an island of warrior women, skilled with bow, blade and bare hands. Ntotelval led a mounted escort until a startled horse threw her from a cliff.

feats.scene: Ntotelval swings a sabre through a practice post and splits it clean.
Ntotelval takes a hard blow from a rival's staff and stays mounted.

reply.summary: Riarnrn is an avant-garde artist who uses microscopic machines in ink to animate her drawings into living weapons. Riarnrn turned vengeful and later pumped the ink into her own skull to summon beasts at will.

feats.scene: Riarnrn sends a snarling ink panther that rips a car door off its hinges.
Riarnrn takes a thrown crate and stays standing amid swirling ink.

reply.summary: Niasillor is the half-surface queen who reigns over most of an ocean world and leads a band of cosmic defenders. Niasillor is her planet's greatest champion and the strategist behind a last stand against a dark emperor.

feats.scene: Niasillor drives a tidal surge that scours a coastline of every shipwreck.
Niasillor stays upright through a wave of crushing deep-sea pressure.

reply.summary: Osraleo is a charming broadcaster who hosts a nightly interview programme in a bustling city. Osraleo confronted a false guest on air and later gave airtime to a citizens' movement.

feats.scene: Osraleo slaps a desk bell so hard it rings out across the studio.
Osraleo stumbles off a low stage and keeps talking.

reply.summary: Telsanta is a pink-skinned noblewoman who loved a future tyrant and bore a child she had to give away. Telsanta rose again as a zombie wielding a ring of death before two foes ended her.

feats.scene: Telsanta fires a black beam that cracks a plateau in two.
Telsanta endures a twin blast of coloured light for several heartbeats before dissolving.

reply.summary: Varnale is an immortal sea-king who blends engineering and sorcery, ruling a drowned civilization of magic-blooded people. Varnale wears a crown of his own design and leads with patient wisdom.

feats.scene: Varnale commands a lattice of enchanted machinery that levels a harbour district.
Varnale stays whole after a vault of crystal collapses upon his throne.

reply.summary: Monto is a green-eyed ring bearer of a galactic peacekeeping corps who tracked a rogue android across space. Monto flies and casts glowing constructs fuelled by willpower.

feats.scene: Monto launches an emerald lance that shatters a drifting asteroid.
Monto shrugs off a ricocheting blast behind a glowing shield.

reply.summary: Saseonel is an eager gold-skinned rookie who peppers her mentor with questions and listens to the corps' old tales. Saseonel solved how to beat a time-bending foe, earning an honoured place in legend.

feats.scene: Saseonel shapes a glowing hammer that crushes a ship's hull.
Saseonel absorbs a ricocheting blast on a shield and grins.

reply.summary: Linvaloll is one of thousands of ring-wearing guardians, a gold-skinned patroller who keeps her identity private. Linvaloll draws on stubborn willpower to shape light into walls and weapons.

feats.scene: Linvaloll fires a green bolt that topples a stone watchtower.
Linvaloll holds a glowing barrier as rubble rains down.

reply.summary: Ninvais is an enthusiastic young peacekeeper who marched into a huge war between rival god-like factions. Ninvais fought alongside every ring-bearer to crush an apocalyptic tyrant and burned to share the tale.

feats.scene: Ninvais joins a huge chorus of rings to blast a fortress moon into slag.
Ninvais keeps a shield up through a cascade of fiery beams.

reply.summary: Anuma is a golden-skinned fighter who rebuilt a shattered peacekeeping order after its elders were slaughtered. Anuma wields rings of both hues and wears her determination like armour.

feats.scene: Anuma sweeps twin beams across a fleet and sets it ablaze.
Anuma tanks a planetoid-shaking impact behind layered shields.

reply.summary: Lusilnan is a gold-skinned ring wearer assigned to a remote patch of space, drawing on will to shape glowing tools. Lusilnan flies, fires light, and defends a sleepy sector alone.

feats.scene: Lusilnan bursts a pirate skiff with a single pulse.
Lusilnan weathers a flurry of plasma bolts on a hastily raised shield.

reply.summary: Tiasasor is a hulking, red-eyed enforcer who wears a ring of fear and cares for nothing but brute force. Tiasasor is tough as slag and flattens lesser fighters by sheer weight.

feats.scene: Tiasasor slams a truck through a warehouse wall.
Tiasasor walks through a collapsing gantry with a shrug.

reply.summary: Llcisau is a clawed, fanged drill sergeant of a villainous corps, big enough to make heroes gawk. Llcisau bellows orders, shrugs off poison, and uses a yellow ring to fly and fire blasts.

feats.scene: Llcisau cracks open a bridge span with a yellow-lit swing.
Llcisau takes a barrage of blasts and keeps barking commands.

reply.summary: Ianiosa is a towering blue brute with sharp teeth and an iron stomach, bound to a ring of fear. Ianiosa can chew glass and has grudgingly bonded with an unlikely partner.

feats.scene: Ianiosa rips a steel door from its frame and hurls it across a hangar.
Ianiosa tumbles through a plate-glass wall and chews the shards.

reply.summary: Siran is a green-skinned bruiser seen only briefly, serving a yellow-lit militia. Siran carries a ring and leaves little else behind besides rumours.

feats.scene: Siran blasts open a barn door with a yellow bolt.
Siran stumbles through a collapsing silo with scrapes.

reply.summary: Vaori is a brown-furred peacekeeper who held the line at his corps' home world during a devastating siege. Vaori flies and fires glowing beams before falling to a tyrant's deadly eye-blast.

feats.scene: Vaori sweeps a green beam across a wave of invaders.
Vaori cannot survive the final red beam but holds out against a hundred before it.

reply.summary: Vareo is a fanged, honourable fighter from a war-torn planet who inherited a dying officer's ring. Vareo challenges every opponent openly and flies on glowing power.

feats.scene: Vareo smashes a stone pillar with a glowing fist.
Vareo holds a shield wall against a volley of arrows and shots.

reply.summary: Seoteium is a white-eyed ring bearer in a harsh alternate world ruled by a tyrant. Seoteium builds shields and blasts and flies on stubborn resolve.

feats.scene: Seoteium blows a tank apart with a beam of green light.
Seoteium takes a fusillade through a shimmering barrier.

reply.summary: Urniallu is a furred ring-wearer who flies using the power of a glowing battery and keeps his identity hidden. Urniallu stands among thousands of peacekeepers on a central world.

feats.scene: Urniallu levels a bunker with a sweeping emerald blast.
Urniallu holds up a shield as a tower of ice falls onto him.

reply.summary: Corent is a mild archivist from a warlike people who beat a ring-bearer using clever design and a yellow war-suit. Corent then inherited the ring and ended a long conflict by gaining political power peacefully.

feats.scene: Corent sends a pulse of green light that cracks a dam wall.
Corent shrugs off a thunderous blast behind a luminous shield.

reply.summary: Ernor is a fur-covered, fang-baring ring wielder who joined a huge war on a rival realm of tyrants. Ernor builds barriers, fires beams, and stays loyal to the corps.

feats.scene: Ernor blasts a drifting war-barge in half.
Ernor holds a shield while a flaming ship streaks past.

reply.summary: Amoeru is a farm wife and devoted mother who raised a prodigy too clever for his surroundings. Amoeru watched her brilliant son grow bitter, and she paid dearly for that rivalry.

feats.scene: Amoeru swings a frying pan at a prowling raccoon.
Amoeru tumbles from a hay cart and stands up laughing.

reply.summary: Leonaces is an orange-skinned reject from a far-future hero academy who can pop off his limbs and swing them like clubs. Leonaces keeps trying anyway, undeterred by constant mockery.

feats.scene: Leonaces hurls a detached arm and knocks a thug's helmet off.
Leonaces loses a leg to a trap door and hops away unfazed.

reply.summary: Taamo is a bitter heir who blames a tycoon for his family's ruin and swaps an arm for a terrible device. Taamo captures a rich man for ransom, but the unstable weapon tears him apart instead.

feats.scene: Taamo's arm-mounted device flares with enough power to crack a world before it unravels.
Taamo braces against a shaking floor as the device whines.

reply.summary: Reslloiu is a former athlete lost through a rift who now hunts across dimensions for a dark mistress. Reslloiu slips between worlds and tracks prey that others lose.

feats.scene: Reslloiu tears open a rift that flings a squad of soldiers across a field.
Reslloiu climbs out of a collapsing rift unscathed.

reply.summary: Tummi is a respected fighting teacher who lost both arms yet trained many students of renown. Tummi fell to a masked assassin while helping another man regain his edge.

feats.scene: Tummi spins and sends a heavy kick that cracks a training post.
Tummi takes a staff blow to the ribs and keeps his stance.

reply.summary: Eollasrau is a trouble-shooting officer who travels the globe in uniform, fixing problems with rifle, sidearm and a tame animal. Eollasrau relies on training and nerve rather than any special gift.

feats.scene: Eollasrau fires a rifle and drops a saboteur across a rail yard.
Eollasrau stays on his feet after a jeep rolls beside him.

reply.summary: Miiletil is a federal investigator who turns into an eel-like predator after drinking cursed water. Miiletil hits as hard as a sea king, slips through water to appear elsewhere, and shrugs off small-calibre fire.

feats.scene: Miiletil tears a steel hatch off a submarine with her jaws.
Miiletil takes a hail of pistol rounds and keeps lunging.
